biocs.name: Uncommon Launch Agent persistency was registered or modified
biocs.description: Detection of registry key modifications related to launch agents that are uncommon in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
